definition: good enough for what is needed
example: The bake sale raised an adequate amount of money for the class trip.

definition: hard but easily cracked or snapped

definition: to make someone do something
example: The heavy rain compelled the referees to stop the game.

definition: saying a lot in few words; short and clear
example: Mr. Ruiz asked for a concise summary of no more than three sentences.

definition: to reduce something until little or none is left

definition: causing sadness or gloom; very poor

definition: extremely happy and excited

definition: able to be done; practical

definition: careful about spending money

definition: showing anger or opposition; unfriendly

definition: treating all sides equally; not taking sides

definition: certain to happen

definition: danger of loss or harm

definition: tired and lacking energy

definition: very small in amount; not enough

definition: a person new to an activity

definition: no longer used because something newer exists

definition: peaceful and not easily upset

definition: very great or intense; showing deep understanding

definition: to get better after illness or effort

definition: to look at or study very carefully

definition: long, slow, and dull

definition: of little value or importance

definition: able to do many different things well

definition: carefully watching for danger or problems

definition: full of strong energy and devotion for a cause

definition: real; not a copy

definition: easy to see or notice; standing out

definition: not proud; modest about oneself

definition: to make or become larger

definition: to speed up

definition: an enemy or opponent
